question: Can every IO-admissible physical observable on h_vec be classified so residual shell-tail freedom is physically null?

executive_verdict.summary: The classification closes for current/banked IO observables but fails universally. Broad P2-admissible h_vec-internal higher-shell diagnostics such as shell energy, shell power, stress-energy, field-strength power, polarization, vector, or non-Gaussian diagnostics can separate residual shell tails.

definitions.name: Banked IO Observable on h_vec
definitions.definition: Observable explicitly present in the current Paper 23-Paper 31 chain, with h_vec dependence through the scalar bridge quotient, Paper 31 rank-one quotient, frozen observer-side scalar-amplitude use, or separate established carrier classes such as Paper 24 TT or Paper 25 weak observables.

definitions.name: Broad P2-Admissible Future Observable on h_vec
definitions.definition: Gauge-invariant or gauge-fixed-then-quotient-invariant observable constructible from standard exterior/interior physics on the physical coexact connection/vector perturbation sector, compatible with P1 background constraints.

theorems.name: Banked Observables Factor Through Known Quotients or Separate Carriers
theorems.claim: Every currently banked IO observable that reads h_vec either factors through the Paper 23 scalar bridge quotient, the Paper 31 rank-one active-line quotient, or belongs to a separate established carrier class.

theorems.name: Broad P2-Admissible Observables Can Separate Residual Shell Tails
theorems.claim: Observables such as O_n(G)=Tr(P_n G P_n) or shell-energy functionals can read higher coexact shell covariance while B DeltaG B^dagger=0.

theorems.name: Banked IO Observable Classification Closure
theorems.claim: For currently banked IO observables involving h_vec, residual shell-tail freedom is either killed by known quotients, outside the observable carrier, excluded as positive-energy background freedom, or not part of the current banked observable.

theorems.name: Universal Admissible-Observable Classification No-Go
theorems.claim: The proposed universal classification fails under broad P2-admissible future observables because h_vec-internal higher-shell diagnostics can separate residual shell tails.

theorems.name: What Would Be Needed to Close the Universal Version
theorems.claim: Universal closure requires a new theorem proving h_vec has no physical observable content beyond the scalar quotient, all higher-shell diagnostics are backreaction-forbidden even as perturbative observables, every such observable has a separately fixed exterior state, or the physical observable algebra is deliberately defined as a quotient.

decisive_obstruction.name: h_vec-internal higher-shell diagnostics
decisive_obstruction.example: O_n(G) = Tr(P_n G P_n), where P_n projects onto a coexact shell outside the scalar-amplitude rank-one quotient
decisive_obstruction.why_it_blocks_universal_classification: B DeltaG B^dagger can vanish while Tr(P_n DeltaG P_n) is nonzero; if h_vec is physical, such shell power/stress observables are standard P2-admissible diagnostics.

must_not_overclaim: Do not claim all IO-admissible future observables on h_vec factor through B G B^dagger.
Do not claim h_vec-internal higher-shell diagnostics are abstract bypasses; they are standard physical observables if h_vec is physical.
Do not claim P1 backreaction exclusion forbids perturbative measurements of residual shell power.
Do not claim banked-observable closure selects the full h_vec state.
